source.test_name: native question reads the same-case public CAPEX answer without confirming pending training and reopens its real thread consumer

scope.principal_review: Semantic legitimacy, provenance, isolation, same-thread pending condition, real consumers and explicit native evidence design.
scope.complementary_review: Types, interfaces and Request mechanics are assigned separately to compose_typecheck. This verdict does not substitute for typecheck or product CI.
scope.method: Read the complete new driver and its closed producer/verifier/consumer/answer paths. Verify full GitHub MCP payload hashes and frozen source/docs. No source imports, product execution, transpilation, typecheck or CI.

findings_resolved.classification: Native evidence-linkage gap in the initial own test
findings_resolved.before: The initial audit inherited actual run/session/call-ID checks from the harness but did not independently compare native receipt input/result digests with the completed Session tool input/result.
findings_resolved.correction: The final audit requires completed non-error assistant messages, matching operation/call IDs, native run/session/principal/call-ID receipt fields and inputDigest/resultDigest equality to the actual tool state. It additionally requires the exact pending case and predecessor question inputs, reconstructs the question input from the actual typed QuestionProposal, and preserves answer-before-question ordering. Relation results remain exact without inventing array ordering.

findings_resolved.before: The preparation document used the imprecise phrase 108-or-inventory-derived.
findings_resolved.correction: The final preparation records 96 components for the eight non-training categories. The existing code formula and coverage assertions were already correct.

semantic_checks.details: Actual Planner2027 source issuance and projection, current-year Project scalar-name selection, selected CAPEX2027 scalar-name selection, and a distinct real homonymous CAPEX are obtained through public ports. The CAPEX source period equals the conversation and case2027 horizon; the current-year Project remains relation context. No EvidenceRef, authority binding, result or native receipt is fabricated.

semantic_checks.topic: Same real thread and C10 pending condition
semantic_checks.details: A real C06 review thread is created for exactly the selected CAPEX and receives a real human reply. Its actual ID is then provided as the human classification questionRef for training through baseline-coverage and decision-promote. The returned case and QuestionPlanningInput must retain that same ID. This is explicit human pending classification; the driver keeps derivedMissingCategoryIds empty and does not claim the separate omitted-category counterproof.

semantic_checks.topic: Unconfirmed is not confirmed cost evidence
semantic_checks.details: The actual sf_answer_read must return the exact predecessor text, selected CAPEX ref and unconfirmed state. No answer-confirm action is granted or called. The C10 entry remains pending, training components remain absent, known subtotal remains210000, full total remains null and comparison remains conditioned. Exact case and raw Planner/Dashboard digests are checked before intentional source withdrawal and after reopening. The typed question contains source context; it does not turn the human reply into a confirmed amount or a domain application.

semantic_checks.topic: Answer scope is supported by the installed C06 path
semantic_checks.details: Host7d8396e2 selects the source from the thread/message basis and requires exact fields and period. With no resolveAnswerScope callback, the fallback accepts one Dashboard record and no material dependencies. Dashboard confirmation manifest/observer support that exact selected capexProjects scalar projection. The thread contains only CAPEX evidence, while the relation and case separately retain Project/CAPEX/Planner. This does not repair or bypass the distinct Planner answer-scope failure.

Question input producer10d95e01 derives the pending condition from the real case and loads the actual confirmed pmo-capex relation and selected recipient twice. The condition evidenceRefs remain empty; the actual relation supplies the authorized refs. Verifierd37b2636 allows the explicit CAPEX subset drawn from those current relation refs and validates case version and recipient. No private field or output is inserted into the input.

Without a model, the driver obtains a real UI preparation receipt, confirms it through question-consume, retries idempotently, adds a real human reply and reopens the same thread and unconfirmed answer. With a model it requires actual Session/SkillLoadReceipt and a C11 QuestionProposal; it reopens the contribution, obtains it through question-output, consumes that contribution through C06 and requires a third host for the new thread. A later empty catalog cannot skip this mandatory native consumer reopen.

semantic_checks.topic: Minimal scope and native receipt/result linkage
semantic_checks.details: The four requested operations case_read, answer_read, relation_read and question_prepare are within the selected Maestro question skill and the host grant. The provider branch uses only a model published by the actual host/catalog. It requires four actual completed tool calls, actual loaded skill provenance, exact input/result digest links and an earlier answer result message before the question preparation result that equals the persisted output payload. No expected QuestionProposal text or tool response is pre-recorded.

The outside-case source is a genuinely issued distinct CAPEX ref with the same public name. Dispatch4a1ebe92 returns denied/source-access-unavailable after the real case read when that ref is not in the authorized case evidence. Capabilityc0bd1afe preserves the refusal reason and supplies a receipt on success and failure; logging result.receipt.kind is valid. The separate raw Request is deliberately outside the harness WeakSet and must not disclose the predecessor body.

semantic_checks.topic: Source withdrawal versus history and ACL
semantic_checks.details: After positive consumers, only the selected physical CAPEX row is removed. The distinct homonymous source remains readable. Both answer lineages and thread HTTP reads must refuse, and any actual native output is reread and refused even if the reopened catalog changes. Authority20b61536 requires fresh refs for ordinary thread reads; recipient-threadad954aef requires current reissuance and authorized historical continuity; refresh9412fa16 requires the physical source to remain alive. The negative is named source withdrawal, not principal ACL revocation.

The old Planner helper assertion, old questions driver, old question consumer, Work driver and shared harness remain byte-identical to their recorded pins. All ten shared helper files match the start-of-review bytes. The v2 code change is confined to inspectNativeCalls. The360000ms deadline is unchanged and is not a measured runtime guarantee. Work-list, handoff, confirmed-answer reuse, Planner integration, derived omission, all required operations and GNATIVE remain unaccepted by this new source.

source_verification.native_message_schema: packages/schema/src/session-message.ts@62aeee3e61a1a2c3dcb0b6de15711357093f7e79 includes state.input and state.structured on completed tool parts.

runtime_limits.performance_claim: None. The driver contains multiple real C06/C09/C10 authorization reads; only its eventual surgical GitHub Actions run can establish outcome and duration.
runtime_limits.other_flights: The unrelated W28 three-case terminal reported by root does not execute this new Answer driver and is not transferred to it.

conclusion: The final isolated Dashboard/CAPEX Answer driver is semantically consistent with the inspected published ports and preserves the unconfirmed/pending boundary. No material static blocker remains in this review. Runtime, native inference and wider WP12 completion remain separate evidence obligations.
